reviewer: Dr Pham (clinical review 2026-09-22), relayed by Sean B
verification: Every PMID fetched live from PubMed (efetch XML) on 2026-09-22; title, publication type and each claim below checked against the abstract, or the open-access full text where named.

decisions.1a_bi07: A - sign off; single-strain credit is the acute lactose-digestion surrogate (36149331) only; 21436726 stays combination evidence
decisions.1b_bb12: A - sign off; human evidence reviewed, mixed/limited
decisions.1c_la5_bb12_combinations: A - approve 30439760 and 39102225 as literal combination records with an unregistered third strain; zero component credit
decisions.section3: Proceed; correct CU1 wording (primary null; respiratory finding post hoc n = 44; 27825987 is safety data)
decisions.nissle_1917: Record 15479682 as affirmative human active-comparator equivalence evidence for UC maintenance, medium strength, not null; no ordinary placebo-superiority credit until the scorer can weight active-comparator evidence
decisions.direction_invariant: A missing direction is unresolved, never positive: every strain evidence summary states effect_direction from its verified cited record, and the probiotic scorer gives a missing direction no credit
decisions.atcc_pta_6475_benefits: Keep bone health only; testosterone, immune and skin effects are animal-model findings
